subject: Service disruption impact & remediation proposal
messages:
From: Elena Torres <elena.torres@novusretail.com>
To: diego_fernandez@redwood.com
Cc: ops@novusretail.com
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Service disruption impact - nightly batch failures

Diego,

This morning (run started ~01:00 PDT) our nightly fulfillment batch began receiving 500/502 responses from your API for a span of ~45 minutes. We saw ~1.2M token requests fail across ~15 worker nodes; downstream retries caused significant queueing and customer-facing order delays. Attached are the logs and two screenshots showing the error spikes.

We need to understand:
- root cause and mitigation timeline
- whether this will be credited or remediated (our CFO is asking about immediate credits)

Please escalate — our P0 on-call flagged this and asked I loop in procurement for any contract implications.

Thanks,
Elena Torres
Head of Platform Operations
Novus Retail
Attachment: novus-error-logs-20270418.txt (text)
Attachment: screenshot-500s.png (image)

From: diego_fernandez@redwood.com
To: Elena Torres <elena.torres@novusretail.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 08:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Service disruption impact - nightly batch failures

Elena — thanks for the heads-up and the logs. I’m sorry Novus experienced that spike; I recognize how disruptive this is during your peak nightly window.

Immediate notes:
- I’ve opened INC-20270418-DRG and forwarded logs to infra/serving. Initial telemetry shows increased tail latency and a short period of degraded routing to a cache-miss path.
- Can you confirm whether retries originated from your side after the first 502s (that helps quantify token counts)?

I’ve looped in Marissa (acct lead) and Karthik (ops finance) to scope a remediation gesture. Tentative offer (pending internal approval): 100k token credit + 30-day trial extension for any new seats created in the next 60 days. Will confirm numbers after we reconcile tokens and exact failure window.

Next steps:
1) I’ll escalate to leadership to approve the credit.
2) We’ll share a short incident summary and a DocuSign addendum if you’d like the credit documented.

From: diego_fernandez@redwood.com
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: markus_klein@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 18:09:00 -07:00
Subject: INTERNAL: Novus Retail — incident summary & proposed gesture

Team — quick internal summary and ask:

What happened:
- 2027-04-18 01:00–01:45 PDT: repeated 500/502 responses from hosted inference for Novus account NR-2024-074 during their nightly batch window.
- Impact: ~1.2M token attempts failed; customer retried which caused longer downstream processing and several order delays.
- Root cause (prelim): degraded routing to a cache-miss execution path coupled with autoscaler slow ramp on a hotspot; infra is doing a deeper postmortem.

Proposal for remediation (ask for quick approval):
- Customer-facing gesture: 100,000 token credit applied to account immediately + 30-day trial extension on their eval seats for recruitment purposes.
- Documentation: short incident summary PDF to customer + DocuSign amendment to record goodwill credit (finance prefers documented approvals).
- Financial cap: recommend not exceeding $12k USD equivalent for this gesture.

Attachments: incident_summary.pdf (contains token math and timeline).

Please reply with APPROVE / ADJUST / DENY so I can communicate to Novus and route DocuSign if needed.

Thanks,
Diego

From: markus_klein@redwood.com
To: diego_fernandez@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 19 Apr 2027 09:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: INTERNAL: Novus Retail — incident summary & proposed gesture

Diego — I support a remediation gesture but want two adjustments before you commit:

1) Reduce the credit to 75,000 tokens and keep the 30-day extension. That keeps the spend within the preferred goodwill band for this severity.
2) Have Procurement/Legal (procurement@novusretail.com) confirm they accept a DocuSign amendment wording; we should not auto-bill any future usage unless explicitly stated.

If Procurement agrees, approve and ask Finance to process the credit. Karhtik — can you confirm we can absorb 75k tokens under the current goodwill budget and prepare the DocuSign template?

Markus
VP, Commercial Operations
Redwood Inference

From: diego_fernandez@redwood.com
To: Elena Torres <elena.torres@novusretail.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, procurement@novusretail.com
Date: Mon, 19 Apr 2027 17:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Novus Retail — approved remediation: credit + trial extension

Elena — thanks for your patience while we reviewed this. We’re sorry again for the disruption; we understand the downstream impact on fulfillment processing.

What we’re providing (approved):
- 75,000 token credit applied to account NR-2024-074 immediately (visible in your billing console within 24 hours).
- 30-day trial extension available to any new eval seats created in your org within the next 60 days.

Documentation and next steps:
- I’ve attached a short incident summary (incident_summary.pdf) that outlines the timeline and token math.
- If Procurement would like the gesture documented, we’ve prepared a simple DocuSign amendment: https://app.docusign.com/novus/amendment-12345. It does not change existing commercial terms — it only records the credit and extension.
- Karhtik has been asked to confirm the accounting entry and the credit schedule.

Please confirm receipt and whether Procurement wants the DocuSign signed. Once Procurement confirms, I’ll mark the ticket resolved.

Sincerely,
Diego Fernandez
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
